<!-- ===== FAQ ===== -->
<section class="section" style="background: var(--paper-deep); border-block: 1px solid var(--line);">

  <div class="section-inner">

      <details>
        <summary>Do I need a referral?</summary>
        <p>No. You can book an appointment directly, without a referral from a doctor.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Are sessions reimbursed?</summary>
        <p>Partly. I am not a contracted psychologist, but your health insurance fund reimburses part of the cost. The amount and the number of sessions differ per fund. You can find more information <a href="https://www.vind-een-psycholoog.be/info/terugbetaling-psychotherapie.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">via this link</a> (in Dutch).</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Can I also have sessions online?</summary>
        <p>Yes. Sessions can take place fully or partly online, for example during internships, training camps or busy research periods.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>I don't do (competitive) sport. Can I still come?</summary>
        <p>Of course. Performing under pressure is not limited to sport. Students, PhD candidates, musicians and professionals are just as welcome.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>How soon can I get an appointment?</summary>
        <!-- TODO: realistische wachttijd bevestigen -->

  </div>
</section>
